note: Arcadia: a game launcher. A library of games with covers, collections, filters and sorting, a page per game with a screenshot carousel, achievements and news, friends with their presence, a downloads queue that advances over time, play stats and a settings page, in English, Italian and Arabic, dark or light. Built from the public docs only; see README.md next to it.

computed.matches: {{filter(state.games, (state.filter == 'all' || (state.filter == 'installed' && it.installed) || (state.filter == 'favourites' && it.favourite) || it.genre == state.filter) && (empty(state.query) || fuzzy(state.query, it.title) != null) && (settings.library.showUninstalled || it.installed))}}
computed.visible: {{settings.library.sortBy == 'playtime' ? sort(computed.matches, it.hours, 'desc') : settings.library.sortBy == 'recent' ? sort(computed.matches, it.lastPlayed, 'desc') : sort(computed.matches, it.title)}}
computed.weekHours: {{[sum(state.games, it.week[0]), sum(state.games, it.week[1]), sum(state.games, it.week[2]), sum(state.games, it.week[3]), sum(state.games, it.week[4]), sum(state.games, it.week[5]), sum(state.games, it.week[6])]}}
computed.collections: {{[{ id: 'all', label: t('coll.all', { n: length(state.games) }) }, { id: 'installed', label: t('coll.installed', { n: computed.installedCount }) }, { id: 'favourites', label: t('coll.favourites', { n: count(state.games, it.favourite) }) }, { id: 'genres', label: t('coll.genres'), children: map(state.genres, { id: it, label: t('genre', { g: it }) }) }]}}
computed.rows: {{map(computed.visible, { id: it.id, cells: [it.title, t('genre', { g: it.genre }), formatNumber(it.hours), it.lastPlayed == state.today ? t('today') : formatDate(it.lastPlayed, 'd MMM', 'utc'), it.installed ? t('status.installed') : t('size.gb', { size: it.sizeGb })] })}}
computed.sessionItems: {{map(state.sessions, { id: it.id, label: t('session.row', { title: it.title, duration: it.minutes >= 60 ? t('duration.h', { h: it.minutes / 60 }) : t('duration.m', { m: it.minutes }), date: formatDate(it.at, 'EEE d MMM', 'utc') }) })}}
computed.friendItems: {{map(computed.shown, { id: it.id, label: t('friend.row', { name: it.name, status: t('presence', { p: it.presence, game: it.game ?? '' }) }), icon: 'circle', iconColor: it.presence == 'ingame' ? '#7c5cff' : it.presence == 'online' ? '#30a46c' : it.presence == 'away' ? '#f5a524' : '#8a92a6' })}}
computed.gameMenu: {{map(menus.game, it.separator ? it : merge(it, { title: t('cmd.' + it.run) }))}}
computed.viewMenu: {{map(menus.view, it.separator ? it : merge(it, { title: t('cmd.' + it.run) }))}}
computed.commandItems: {{map(commands, merge(it, { title: t('cmd.' + it.name), detail: t('cat', { c: it.category }) }))}}
